Creepy moment Yorkshire Ghost Guy captures spooky 'figure' on camera at Duke of York castle

Yorkshire Ghost Guy Andrew captured the footage while visiting Sandal Castle.

17:00, 17 Oct 2026

Sandal Castle ghost capture by Yorkshire Ghost Guy

A YouTuber says he captured an image of a "ghostly figure" while filming at Sandal Castle, a ruined medieval fortress in Wakefield.

‌

‌

Self-styled ghost hunter Andrew, from Rotherham, who goes by the name Yorkshire Ghost Guy, posted a video on his social media channel and shared it with Yorkshire Live. He said: "(It is a) short video of what I believe may be a ghostly figure captured at Sandal Castle."

‌

In the footage he points out that a shadow appears tp cross the view in front of him before an orb of light appears.

‌

He added: "I started 'ghost hunting' after the death of my father in 2003. I’ve been to the castle a few times and I upload my findings to my YouTube channel Yorkshire Ghost Guy."

‌

During the Wars of the Roses, Richard Plantagenet, 3rd Duke of York, used Sandal Castle as his northern base. On December 30, 1460, the Duke left the high ground and safety of the castle to engage a huge Lancastrian army on the plains below where he and his men were surrounded and slaughtered.
